subject: english
stem: What happens next in this passage after “The owner always says, 'Think about the item, your money, and the next customer.'”?
options: Repair Morning is not a store, so people do not pay.
Still, many people treat it carefully.
Money disappears quietly when people do not pay attention.

optionRationales.reason: 本文沒有陳述「Repair Morning is not a store, so people do not pay.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文可直接核對「The owner always says, 'Think about the item, your money, and the next customer.' Most people pay carefully.」，所以這個選項符合完整語境。
本文沒有陳述「Still, many people treat it carefully.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「Money disappears quietly when people do not pay attention.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。

provenance.copyrightStatus: Original wording; official sources used only for scope and assessment calibration.

independentReviews.evidence: 獨立覆核 A：在鎖定文章中定位「The owner always says, 'Think about the item, your money, and the next customer.' Most people pay carefully.」，答案為「Most people pay carefully.」。
獨立覆核 B：逐項回查文章，只有「Most people pay carefully.」有同篇證據，三個干擾項均來自不同情境。
